authored_under: Round 111 cell DB-b-224 (issuer 2.0.0_SA_COO~D2, decomposition section 113). Model: IRPT_DASHBD_ACCOUNT_RETURN_DAILY_CONTRACT.json (columns form, schema_hash and schema_hash_basis). Opened by the report contract's open_changes line 1: a household daily return series built the way the account series is built is a new contract.

columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: The firm id of the registry row the household was read for. A value, never a code.

columns.name: household_id
columns.meaning: The household: the ADVI crosswalk relationship id that its member accounts share (the accounts present in the account gold).

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: The trading day t, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: market_value_eod
columns.meaning: Sum of the end-of-day market values V_t over ALL of the household's accounts with a row on t.

columns.name: external_flow
columns.meaning: Sum of the external flows F_t over ALL of the household's accounts with a row on t (capital in positive).

columns.name: total_return_daily
columns.meaning: The household's daily return r_t: the prior-day-value weighted combination of its accounts' own total_return_daily over the accounts in S (weight V_p(a), the account's market_value_eod on the previous date). Null where the day cannot be measured (ACCOUNT_MISSING, NO_PRIOR_VALUE): never zero.

columns.name: accounts_n
columns.meaning: Count of the household's accounts with a row on t.

columns.name: day_quality
columns.meaning: MEASURED (r_t computed), ACCOUNT_MISSING (a member with a row on the previous date has none on t), NO_PRIOR_VALUE (no previous date, a base not above zero, or an empty base).

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: The method version of THE METHOD in this contract (1).

columns.name: schema_version
columns.meaning: The contract_version this row was written under.

method: THE METHOD (amended on worker row IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W179-S1: the first cut chained the summed values and flows, which does not reproduce an account's own linked return on a carried or large-flow day). For a household and a trading day t with previous date p (the previous date on which the household has any row), let S be the accounts with a row on BOTH p and t. r_t = (sum over S of V_p(a) * r_t(a)) / (sum over S of V_p(a)), where V_p(a) is the account's market_value_eod on p (the weight) and r_t(a) is the account's OWN total_return_daily on t, used as it is, so the producer's linked return on a carried or large-flow day is carried into the household. Where every account's return is the endpoint form (V_t - F_t) / V_p - 1 this equals (sum V_t - sum F_t) / sum V_p - 1 over S; for a one-account household r_t is that account's return. An account with a row on p and none on t makes day t ACCOUNT_MISSING and r_t null (never zero); so does an account of S whose total_return_daily is null on t. An account with a row on t and none on p joins the household that day: it is outside S for that day, and its value enters the base from the next day. r_t is null with NO_PRIOR_VALUE when the household has no previous date, when sum V_p over S is not above zero, or when S is empty. market_value_eod, external_flow and accounts_n are the sum, the sum and the count over ALL of the household's accounts with a row on t. The window return is the product of (1 + r_t) over the trading days after the window's opening anchor up to and including as_of, minus one, and is null if any r_t in the window is null. The account return members of the report fold the same way (account_return_daily total_return_daily).
schema_hash_basis: sha256 over the sorted 'name:type' lines joined by newline, types as the pyarrow type name the producer's ARROW_SCHEMA carries (the account contract's stated basis). The check recomputes it against the producer's columns, so contract and artifact cannot drift.
firm_specific_columns: NONE. A firm-specific column is a contract violation (C-SHAPE). The function names no firm; the firm enters only as the firm column's value, taken from the registry row.
